Identify and prioritize growth levers across acquisition, conversion, AOV, repeat purchase, pricing, assortment and retention

Balance growth with profitability and build a scalable business model
Own overall category strategy and continuously expand the assortment
Identify whitespace and new product/category opportunities from customer needs and trends
Drive SKU-level performance: pick winners, fix underperformers, improve portfolio mix
Own the customer journey across app and web store, from discovery through post-purchase
Improve traffic, CTR, conversion, AOV, repeat rate and customer lifetime value
